name: Yoshikawa Kazuto
source:
A naive, good-hearted young man. 
He has an NTR fetish but unaware of it. 
He is jealous of his best friend Rintarou who recently got a girlfriend. 
He had a crush on Ayase but doesn't have the courage to confess.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc065/character_4.html]official website[/url]]
